# Test audio fixtures

Synthetic white noise (no third-party audio, no copyright issue), encoded once with ffmpeg so the tests have real encoded files in formats JUCE can read but not write:

* `noise_stereo_44100.mp3`: 8 s, stereo, 44.1 kHz, 128 kbps (libmp3lame).
* `noise_mono_48000.mp3`: 8 s, mono, 48 kHz, 96 kbps (libmp3lame).
* `noise_mono_48000.m4a`: 8 s, mono, 48 kHz, AAC 96 kbps. Only decoded on macOS (CoreAudio); on other platforms the test checks that it is refused with a clear message.

WAV, AIFF, FLAC and Ogg Vorbis test files are generated by the tests themselves with JUCE's writers.
